verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official CLI that reviews local changes before you push and generates a prompt your coding agent can use to fix the findings, and a probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. That is an agent-oriented CLI shipped by the product itself, but the documented scope is narrow and thinly detailed. Missing for 10: command reference, install and auth details, CLI functionality beyond local review, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The **cubic CLI** reviews local changes before you push. It finds bugs and generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them.
We recommend connecting ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code for access to more capable review models.
